newsitem.title: USA: Old Guard sees increase in direct written premiums.
newsitem.headline: Old Guard sees increase in direct written premiums.

text.p: Old Guard Group Inc said Wednesday direct written premiums for the first quarter showed a moderate increase, a trend it expects will continue throughout 1997.
The company also said full-year 1997 results will compare favorably to 1996 results.
The company said its First Delaware acquisition contributed modestly to net income in the first quarter and should have a stronger impact on results moving forward.
The company said it is continuing to pursue acquisitions, and it is placing a greater emphasis on marketing efforts in commercial business lines.
The company also said it expected proceeds generated from its initial public offering would increase its net investment income as the year progresses.
